discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and development of GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology moved from basic peptide-hormone discovery to drugs with huge effects on diabetes, obesity and cardiovascular outcomes. The trio has already won the Lasker (2024) and Breakthrough Prizes, which often come before a Nobel. Recent Medicine prizes (mRNA, microRNA, regulatory T cells) have not touched metabolism, so this field is due.
